criteria.text: Android signing passwords are not present in child-process command-line arguments.
criteria.test_id: issue-1225-c1: spawned Android signing argv never contains passwords

criteria.text: Signing secrets are supplied through a restricted temporary mechanism or environment that is removed after use.
criteria.test_id: issue-1225-c2: signing secrets use child-only environment and are scrubbed from the build process

criteria.text: Failure output never prints signing passwords or a secret-bearing command.
criteria.test_id: issue-1225-c3: failed Android build output redacts signing secrets and argv

criteria.text: An automated guard test fails if signing secrets appear in spawned argv or logged failure output.
criteria.test_id: issue-1225-c4: source guard rejects secret-bearing spawn and failure logging
